sections.heading: Start where AI saves the most.
sections.lead: The AI check-up is our usual first project. We learn how your team works, find where AI could save you time or money, and hand you a written plan with a fixed quote for the first fix.

facts.caption: The whole check-up, at a fixed price
From the first call to your written plan

images.source: Editorial illustration on a Daylight background. A single satin ribbon path in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan runs in from the lower left across calm, pale faceted paper hills and splits into three branches. The two longer branches wind away toward the far hills; the shortest branch, nearest the viewer, curves to a stop beside a young faceted paper sapling that is already putting out its first leaves: of three possible paths, the first step that pays off soonest. Partner Navy only in the deepest shaded facets of the hills. Calm, open Daylight sky across the top third. About 1:1 (604x600), keep the split and the sapling inside the centre so it crops to 4:5. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.

sections.job: Show the Understand and Plan steps applied to the partner: interviews, a walk through their tools and their slowest processes, then how we weigh and check the fixes.
sections.heading: We listen first, then we plan.
sections.lead: The check-up covers the first two of our four steps. Building the fix is a separate decision, and the plan is yours either way.

items.title: Interviews with your team
items.text: We talk with the people who do the work, not only the managers, and repeat the problem back in their words.

items.title: A walk through your tools
items.text: Your CRM, help desk, accounting software and spreadsheets: what each one does, and where work gets typed twice.

items.title: Your slowest processes, start to finish
items.text: We follow each slow, manual step and note how long it takes and who it waits on.

items.title: Each opportunity, weighed
items.text: We estimate the time or money each fix would save, from your own records where you have them, and the work it would take.

items.title: The simplest fix first
items.text: AI, automation, better design or a tool you already pay for. We recommend the one that does the job.

items.title: Checked with your team
items.text: We walk you through what we found before we write it up, so nothing in the plan is a surprise.

items.title: After the check-up
items.text: Build, and Run and grow, only if you want them, at the price in your fixed quote. You can also take the plan to your own team or anyone else.

sections.mobile: Head stacked; each phase opens on its marker and a short ribbon rule, rows below; the aside and link last.

sections.job: Name the three deliverables and show a framed SAMPLE report preview that links to the sample report page.
sections.heading: A plan, a price and a straight answer.
sections.lead: At the end of the check-up you get three things, in writing. They are yours to keep, whatever you decide next.

items.title: A written plan, ranked by what it saves
items.text: Every opportunity we found, ordered by the time or money it would save and the work it would take, with the fix we recommend for each.

items.title: A fixed quote for the first fix
items.text: One price for the fix we recommend first, listing everything it includes. Changes are quoted before we do them.

items.title: Honest advice when AI is not the answer
items.text: If a simpler fix or a tool you already pay for would do the job, we say so, even when it means less work for us.

sections.job: Say who the check-up suits and, honestly, when to skip it.
sections.heading: For teams that know AI could help.
sections.lead: It suits companies whose teams are buried in slow, manual work and who want a clear plan before they spend.

items.title: A good fit if
items.text: Your team types the same information into more than one system. / The same questions, quotes or reports come back every week. / You want a plan and a fixed price before you commit to a build. / You can bring the people who do the work into a few short interviews.

items.title: Skip it if
items.text: You already know what you want built. Ask us for a fixed quote instead (link). / You need a developer on your team now. Read about embedded developers (link).

sections.job: Take the booking: the form with the page's second Primary, and what to have ready beside it.
sections.heading: Book your AI check-up.
sections.lead: Tell us a little about your team and pick a time for the first call. It is a one-hour video call, and we spend most of it listening.

aside.title: What to have ready
items: The two or three tasks that take your team the most time each week. Rough hours are fine.
The tools you use today, such as your CRM, help desk or accounting software.
A colleague who does the work day to day, if they can join.
aside.dataNote: Please don’t send passwords or customer data. We agree on access together, and your data stays in your systems wherever possible. Read how we handle data (link).

fields.label: Where your team is
fields.help: We show call times in your time zone.

fields.label: What slows your team down?
fields.placeholder: For example: we type every order from email into our system by hand.

fields.label: Pick a time for the first call

Wednesday, November 18, 5:00 pm EST (6:00 am Thursday in Manila)
Thursday, November 19, 7:00 pm EST (8:00 am Friday in Manila)
None of these. Email me other times.
fields.help: Shown in your time zone, New York (EST), with our time in Manila.

fields.label: I agree that Alliance AI Partners may use these details to arrange my AI check-up, as set out in the privacy policy.

sections.job: Answer the five questions people ask before booking.
sections.heading: Questions about the check-up (set on two lines: 'Questions about' / 'the check-up')
sections.lead: Short answers to what founders ask before they book. Anything else, ask us on the first call.

faq.a: About [two weeks] from the first call to your written plan. Most of that time is ours: your team joins the first call and a few short interviews.
From [PRICE]. We confirm the fixed price on the first call, before any work starts, and any change is quoted before we do it.

faq.q: Do we have to hire you to build the fixes?
faq.a: No. The plan is yours. Build the fixes with your own team, with someone else, or with us at the price in your fixed quote.

faq.q: What if AI is not the answer?
faq.a: Then we say so, and tell you what would work better, even when it means less work for us.

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: An hour for the first call, a few short interviews with the people who do the work, and a look at the tools you use. No passwords or customer data before we meet.
